conclusion: The AT&T bootloader contains an early Volume-Up-only recovery selection path. Current evidence does not establish why the owner missed it; cold-key timing, early power-reason bypass and stored factory-mode state are distinct from menu/BCB routing.

findings.evidence: At0x9183dc54..0x9183dc70 key0x115 must be pressed and0x116 released. Native string0x9187bd2c names this Volume Up. Helper0x9184479c returns a bit from the key-state bitmap. Both keys/neither follow the no-key route; this is an early sample, not a later menu key handler.
At0x9183de54..0x9183df10, selector0x918951dc==0 makes Up set the actual recovery flag0x918a2d74 directly. The same flag selects recovery GPT partition and /recovery verifier target.

Immediately preceding sample,0x9183dc18/DC1c supplies literal bootmode atVA0x91876870 to integer getter0x918373c8. If retrieved value!=1 selector0x918951dc is cleared. If value==1 Up instead sets is_keyquit_ftm_pressed=1/is_keyenter_ftm_pressed=0; downstream0x91839ac8..0x91839b08 logs NORMAL and saves bootmode0. This is not an unlock/security flag.

Nonzero return from0x918320d0 at0x9183db64..0x9183db6c skips the stored-mode/key sample and PMIC reboot-reason read. Helper inspects PMIC power-off reason registers0x80c/0x80d plus0x80a/0x80b condition, including values0x20/0x80. No current hardware values or path trace available.
Menu Recovery dispatch0x91811028 calls reboot(1)0x918321a0, storing PMIC reason bits for next entry; Start action0x91811088 calls reboot(0). This does not establish that a cold-held Up was sampled.

Normal loader0x9183dbf8 invokes eMMC BCB reader0x9183f748. Exact command boot-recovery sets0x918a2d74 independently of PMIC reason; native recovery clears BCB. Test22/Test24 actual-slot recovery and clear were separately verified by root.

stored_bootmode.read_evidence: 0x918374a0 locates GPT literal ztecfg0x91879e00;0x918374ec adds4096;0x918374f8 sets read count4096;0x918374fc calls storage read.
stored_bootmode.record_layout: 32 records,128B each. NUL-terminated header+0=this-is-cfg-head; key+32; signature+64=cfg-signature-is-here; ASCII integer value+96. Getter0x91837108 finds first valid matching record;0x918373f8..0x91837404 parses value.
stored_bootmode.local_backup_result: No ztecfg file in original backup set or private filename inventory; no stored bootmode value claimed. Fresh misc does not cover this separate partition.
stored_bootmode.naming_note: _LMP was an analyst label for state, not the literal key passed by this aboot.

safe_next_diagnostic: First clarify whether Volume Up was held before pressing Power from a fully off, USB-disconnected state, or only after startup/Start appeared. Root can optionally read the exact4KiB ztecfg table read-only and report only a validated bootmode integer. Do not alter it. Distinguish early-key result from later menu selection and record resulting screen/bootmode; do not infer failure from the warning/Start screen alone.
limits: No current bootloader trace, key bitmap or PMIC register values.
No claim that every power-on reaches the early key sample.
Correct cold-key sequence still awaits owner observation.
